question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?

-- Recheck total with explicit DISTINCT
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.PID, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) as film_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL AND mc.PID IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PID) FROM actor_years

    SELECT DISTINCT mc.PID, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) as film_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL AND mc.PID IS NOT NULL
),
actor_gaps AS (
    SELECT PID, film_year,
           LAG(film_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY film_year) as prev_year,
           film_year - LAG(film_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY film_year) as gap
    FROM actor_years
),
actor_stats AS (
    SELECT PID, 
           COUNT(*) as num_films,
           MAX(gap) as max_gap
    FROM actor_gaps
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN max_gap IS NULL OR max_gap <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as num_actors_no_gap_gt_4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN max_gap IS NOT NULL AND max_gap > 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as num_actors_with_gap_gt_4,
    COUNT(*) as total_actors
FROM actor_stats
